example.name: Name must be at least 2 characters

BearerAuth.description: Enter your JWT token (Bearer prefix is added automatically).

info.description: This API provides endpoints for managing rooms and categories.
info.title: Webby.RoomService

get.description:
Retrieve a **paginated** list of room categories. Supports optional **search** by name.
**Query Parameters Fallback:**
* Invalid, missing, or non-numeric `page` values will default to **1**.
* Invalid, missing, or non-numeric `limit` values (<1) will default to **10**. Limits >100 are capped at **100**.
* `search`: optional string to filter categories by name (case-insensitive)

parameters.description: Items per page (defaults to 10 if invalid, max 100)
parameters.name: limit

post.description:
Create a new room category for organizing rooms.
**Validation Rules:**
* Name is **required** (cannot be null, empty, or whitespace-only)
* Name length must be **2-50 characters**
* Category name must be **unique** (409 Conflict if already exists)
**Security Note:**
* **ONLY ADMINISTRATORS** are authorized to perform this action.

400.description: Invalid input data: name missing, empty, too short (<2), too long (>50), or whitespace-only. Also: malformed JSON, wrong Content-Type

delete.description:
Delete a room category by ID. **Permanent action - cannot be undone.**
**Path Parameter Validation:**
* `id`: must be a valid UUID v4 format
**Security Note:**
* **ONLY ADMINISTRATORS** are authorized to perform this action.

204.description: Category successfully deleted - No Content returned

put.description:
Update an existing room category by ID. Only the **name** field is updateable.
**Validation Rules:**
* Name is **required** (cannot be null, empty, or whitespace-only)
* Name length must be **2-50 characters**
**Path Parameter Validation:**
* `id`: must be a valid UUID v4 format
**Security Note:**
* **ONLY ADMINISTRATORS** are authorized to perform this action.

requestBody.description: Category update data - Name (2-50 chars, required, non-whitespace)

400.description: Invalid input: name missing, empty, too short (<2), too long (>50), whitespace-only, invalid UUID in path, or malformed JSON

post.description:
Create a new room with a name, **category ID**, privacy setting, and optional **thumbnail**.
**Validation Rules:**
* `name`: **required**, 2-50 characters, cannot be null/empty/whitespace-only
* `categoryId`: **required**, must be a valid UUID v4 format
* `isPrivate`: **required**, must be valid boolean ("true" or "false")
* `thumbnail`: optional file upload, max 2MB
**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**

requestBody.description: Room name (2-50 chars, required, non-whitespace) | Category ID (required) | Visibility flag (required): 'true' or 'false' | Room thumbnail image (optional, max 2MB)

400.description: Invalid input: name empty/too short/too long, invalid categoryId UUID, invalid isPrivate boolean, file too large or missing required fields

get.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of all rooms created by the authenticated user.
**Query Parameter Validation:**
* `page`: **optional** (default: 1), must be >= 1, must be numeric
* `limit`: **optional** (default: 10), must be 1-100, must be numeric
**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**
* Returns **only** the authenticated user's rooms
* List includes both public and private rooms owned by the user

400.description: Invalid query parameters: page or limit not numeric, or outside valid range

get.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of all publicly visible rooms in the system.
**Query Parameter Validation:**
* `page`: **optional** (default: 1), must be >= 1, must be numeric
* `limit`: **optional** (default: 10), must be 1-100, must be numeric
* `search`: **optional**, filters rooms by name (case-insensitive partial match)
* `category`: **optional**, filters rooms by category ID (UUID v4 format)
**Security Note:**
* Returns **only** public rooms (private rooms are excluded)
* Pagination prevents excessive data retrieval

parameters.description: Filter by category ID (optional, UUID v4 format)
parameters.name: category

400.description: Invalid query parameters: page or limit not numeric, or outside valid range

post.description:
Retrieve room information using its unique invite token.
**Request Body Validation:**
* `token`: **required**, cannot be empty or whitespace-only
**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**

400.description: Invalid request body or missing token

404.description: Room with given token not found

post.summary: Get a room by invite token

delete.description:
Delete a room by ID. **Permanent action - cannot be undone.**
**Path Parameter Validation:**
* `id`: must be a valid UUID v4 format
**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**
* **Only the authorized room creator** can delete this room

204.description: Room successfully deleted - No Content returned

403.description: Not authorized - only creator or admin can delete

get.description:
Retrieve a room by its ID.
**Access Rules:**
* Only the **room creator (host)** can retrieve the room by ID
**Path Parameter Validation:**
* `id`: must be a valid UUID v4 format
**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**

403.description: Access denied - only the room creator can retrieve

put.description:
Update a room's name, **category ID**, privacy setting, and **thumbnail** by ID.
**Validation Rules:**
* `name`: **required**, 2-50 characters, cannot be null/empty/whitespace-only
* `categoryId`: **required**, must be a valid UUID v4 format
* `isPrivate`: **required**, must be valid boolean ("true" or "false")
* `thumbnail`: optional file upload, max 2MB
**Path Parameter Validation:**
* `id`: must be a valid UUID v4 format
**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**
* **Only the authorized room creator** can update this room

requestBody.description: Room name (2-50 chars, required) | Category ID (UUID v4, required) | Visibility flag ('true' or 'false', required) | New thumbnail image (optional, max 2MB)

400.description: Invalid input: name validation failed, invalid UUID, invalid boolean, file too large, or missing required fields

403.description: Not authorized - only creator or admin can update

get.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of members for a specific room.
**Query Parameter Validation:**
* `page`: **optional** (default: 1), must be >= 1, must be numeric
* `limit`: **optional** (default: 10), must be 1-100, must be numeric
* `search`: **optional**, filters members by username (case-insensitive partial match)
**Path Parameter Validation:**
* `id`: must be a valid UUID v4 format
**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**

400.description: Invalid UUID format or query parameters

get.description:
Retrieve the playback queue for a room with enriched media data.
Pagination is based on individual videos: standalone videos count as 1, each video inside a playlist counts as 1.
Playlists are returned with their `children` truncated to the videos that fall within the current page.
**Query Parameter Validation:**
* `page`: **optional** (default: 1), must be >= 1, must be numeric
* `limit`: **optional** (default: 10), must be 1-100, must be numeric
**Path Parameter Validation:**
* `id`: must be a valid UUID v4 format (room ID)
**Access Rules:**
* Only **room members** can view the queue
**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**

400.description: Invalid UUID format or invalid query parameters

403.description: Access denied - only room members can view the queue

post.description:
Add a video or playlist to the room's playback queue.
**Request Body Validation:**
* `entityId`: **required**, must be a valid UUID v4 format
* `entityType`: **required**, must be either "video" or "playlist"
**Path Parameter Validation:**
* `id`: must be a valid UUID v4 format (room ID)
**Access Rules:**
* Only **room members** can add items to the queue
**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**

403.description: Access denied - only room members can add to queue

delete.description:
Remove a video or playlist from the room's playback queue.
**Path Parameter Validation:**
* `id`: must be a valid UUID v4 format (room ID)
* `itemId`: must be a valid UUID v4 format (queue item ID)
**Access Rules:**
* Only **room members** can remove items from the queue
**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**
**PAY ATTENTION:**
* ONLY A SEPARATE VIDEO OR THE PLAYLIST ITSELF CAN BE DELETED, THE VIDEO FROM THE PLAYLIST CAN NOT BE DELETED SEPARATELY**

403.description: Access denied - only room members can remove from queue
